Gift cooldown retains the same single integer number of weeks and future availability. Gift readiness, rest and networking descriptions do not assert a reward or new mechanic.

The Gangnam aphorism keeps 江南 as place and aspiration; the river retains 汉江/漢江. No character name is converted into an invented Han name.
Warmth terms preserve the distinction between unfamiliar/awkward/developing relations and act-4 imminent rupture/drifting. 几近断联 and 關係瀕臨斷裂 describe risk, not an already-broken relationship.
The hint preserves [b]...[/b], LB/RB, arrows, spacing structure, and the ordered three substitutions: south, east, selected action title. 手柄/手把 and 翻页/換頁 follow the existing regional glossary.
